evals.prompt: Get repository info and open bug issues for acme/backend on GitHub
expectations: Uses repo_info action with owner acme and repo backend
Uses get_issues action with state open and labels including bug
Returns structured JSON with repo metadata and issue list

evals.prompt: Search for AuthService class in acme/backend repo and fetch the file
expectations: Uses search_code action with query containing AuthService
Uses get_file action with the discovered file path
Validates file size before returning content
